product.description: Embrace a world of luxury with the David Jones Prestige Credit Card. A world of unforgettable benefits is always at your fingertips when you shop with the David Jones Prestige credit card. Unlock exclusive experiences, irresistible offers, extraordinary travel rewards and airport lounge access. Plus, earn and redeem David Jones Points when you shop.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Applicants must be at least 18 years old.
Have an income of at least $30,000 gross per year, from employment or investments. Be able to demonstrate a good credit history for the last 5 years
A resident of Australia or a temporary resident who legally has the right to work in Australia (and intend to stay) for at least the next 12 months.
Details to have at hand: A driver licence, passport or medicare card to help verify your identity. Details about your income, living expenses & debts.
Product is only eligible for a natural person.

features.additionalInfo: Add an additional cardholder: Invite someone special into your world of luxury with no additional fees.  Additional Cardholder must be 16 years of age or over. The Primary Cardholder will be liable to pay for all transactions made by Additional Cardholder. Can have one or more additional cardholders.
Get 5% credit back on David Jones purchases when redeemed within 30 days in the Latitude App or Latitude Service Centre. Capped at $350 annually
3 points per $1 at David Jones. 1 point per $1 everywhere else.
features.additionalValue: Earn David Jones credit card points

Minimum Monthly Payment

The minimum monthly payment for a statement period is an amount equal to the greater of $30 or 2.75% of the closing balance, shown on your statement of account.
If your outstanding balance is less than $30, you must pay that balance.
